status: research-only guarded proposals; root application required

changes.before: Let a balanced sutured manifold be taut. For a specified coherent orientation class, its integral sutured Floer homology has a direct summand isomorphic to the integers. More precisely, a finite good taut hierarchy terminating in product balls induces a split inclusion of the terminal product homology into the original homology, with orientation classes induced along the cuts.
changes.after: Assume the Axiom of Choice for the analytic existence and invariant chain-comparison assertions. Let a balanced sutured manifold be taut. For a specified coherent orientation class, its integral sutured Floer homology has a direct summand isomorphic to the integers. More precisely, a finite good taut hierarchy terminating in product balls induces a split inclusion of the terminal product homology into the original homology, with orientation classes induced along the cuts.

changes.before: For an actual weakly admissible balanced sutured diagram on a surface with boundary, the integral disk complex exists for each specified coherent orientation class. Its disk, triangle and quadrilateral moduli spaces admit finite signed counts and the corresponding oriented boundary identities on actual weakly admissible multidiagrams. Sphere and one-torus boundary bubbles are excluded by the zero boundary-region multiplicities. Orientation classes are transported rather than declared equivalent.

changes.before: An actual good decomposing surface admits an adapted admissible nice diagram. For a specified coherent orientation class on the exterior complex, the outer summand of that diagram is integrally chain isomorphic to the cut diagram with the induced orientation class; nonzero periodic domains are retained by pullback of characters. When the surface separates into two balanced pieces, every generator is outer and the full complex is identified with the graded tensor product of the two component complexes. In particular the usual two-piece horizontal decomposition has this chain formula. It gives the homology tensor formula over every field; over the integers it gives the graded Künneth exact sequence including Tor.

changes.before: Let a balanced sutured manifold have connected positive and negative boundary faces. An essential separating product-annulus decomposition into balanced pieces admits a graded integral tensor chain equivalence, with coherent orientation classes induced from the specified class. This realizes the homology tensor formula over every field and the integral Künneth formula with Tor. Product-disk decompositions and product one-handle additions have literal integral complex identifications. The closure construction for any connected pair of faces identifies its top knot complex with the actual sutured disk complex using the specified marking and orientation class.

changes.before: Two balanced Heegaard diagrams of the same marked sutured manifold are connected by relative attaching-circle isotopies, own-family disk slides, and ordinary stabilizations and destabilizations. An ordinary stabilization can be moved by such slides to the true boundary region. These moves induce integral chain homotopy equivalences for the transported coherent orientation class. The product sutured manifold has integral homology equal to one copy of the integers; on a homology-product branch the periodic-domain character ambiguity vanishes.
changes.after: Two balanced Heegaard diagrams of the same marked sutured manifold are connected by relative attaching-circle isotopies, own-family disk slides, and ordinary stabilizations and destabilizations. An ordinary stabilization can be moved by such slides to the true boundary region. Under the Axiom of Choice, these moves induce integral chain homotopy equivalences for the transported coherent orientation class, and the product sutured manifold has integral homology equal to one copy of the integers. For supplied actual coherent systems on a homology-product branch, the periodic-domain character ambiguity vanishes.

changes.before: For an actual nice admissible good surface diagram whose cut has zero periodic-domain group, the outer differential and the cut differential are identified over the integers after changing generator signs. This identifies the top Alexander homology with the integral homology of the cut diagram when the surface is the marked Seifert surface and the outer degree is its genus. The conclusion applies in particular to a fiber cut and to the rank-one branch of the cut Euler-matrix reduction.
